purpose: Explain uVision's implicit effects on a dependency record's F() command. The .dep is written BEFORE the tool runs (the command is the 'to be executed' image), so nothing in it is evidence for the opposite order.

differences_vs_current_flags.Optim: record says -O1, project file says 2 -> the record was written when the target still used -O1
differences_vs_current_flags.defines: record carries STM32F10X_MD twice -> the target Define was then 'STM32F10X_MD,STM32F10X_MD'

injected_options_in_order_of_each_record.rte_device_include: -I<abs>\Arm\Packs\Keil\<vendor>.<pack>\<version>\Device\Include ; derived from RTEPATH (TOOLS.INI) + the target's PackID/Device, independent of Cads IncludePath
injected_options_in_order_of_each_record.uvision_version: __UVISION_VERSION (543 for MDK 5.43): -D"..." for armcc, --pd "... SETA n" for armasm
injected_options_in_order_of_each_record.defines: each text define of Cads.VariousControls.Define, in order, one -D per token (asm: one --pd per token)

output_path_rendering: object/depend/listing paths are project-relative and the directory case follows the project's OutputDirectory/ListingPath as written ('.\Objects\' in the project gives '.\objects\' here)
